name: Poster dive
description: Zoom into the face on a kiosk poster until the artwork fills the frame and becomes the film.

recipe.build: Scale the mockup plate toward a point of interest (origin set on it) while a masked rectangle grows to full frame; same artwork underneath.

use_when: Bridge from a real-world mockup to the film image (match cut through an object).
avoid: Do not use without a mockup plate with a clear focal point.

code.example: RasanMoves.posterDive(tl, 0.3, { target: stage, image: RasanMoves.placeholder.art(2), fx: 0.62, fy: 0.38 });
